# Environment Variables

Every variable Core reads in its default configuration, grouped by the
top-level config key it sets. Set a variable in `.env` or the process
environment to change the default; set the config path in your
application `Config` to override it in code. The default column shows the
source expression: a nested `Env::get()` is a fallback variable, and
constants such as `APP_PATH` are resolved at bootstrap.

Core reads 625 variables in 38 sections.

## Path Constants

Core defines these constants before it builds the config, unless your
bootstrap already defined them (the App skeleton does, in `bootstrap.php`).

| Constant | Variable | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ROOT_PATH` | `ROOT_PATH` | `(getcwd() ?: '.') . '/'` |
| `VENDOR_PATH` | `VENDOR_PATH` | `ROOT_PATH . 'vendor/'` |
| `CORE_PATH` | `CORE_PATH` | `mb_substr(__DIR__, 0, mb_strlen(basename(__DIR__)) * -1)` |
| `APP_PATH` | `APP_PATH` | `null` |
| `APP_ENV` | `APP_ENV` | `null` |
| `PUBLIC_PATH` | `PUBLIC_PATH` | `ROOT_PATH . 'public/'` |
| `STORAGE_PATH` | `STORAGE_PATH` | `ROOT_PATH . 'storage/'` |
| `RESOURCES_PATH` | `RESOURCES_PATH` | `ROOT_PATH . 'resources/'` |
